main.description: Assert a cable LANDING STATION into the kotoba Datom log (:station/*). Coordinates are rounded to the landing town when sourcing is representative (watatsuna G1 — public siting only; manhole-precise location is out of scope).

latMicrodeg.description: WGS84 latitude × 1e6 (microdegrees); G1 — rounded to the landing town when sourcing=representative

lonMicrodeg.description: WGS84 longitude × 1e6 (microdegrees); G1 — rounded to the landing town when sourcing=representative

chokepoint.description: named maritime chokepoint(s) this station's seaward routes sit behind; drives resilience analysis (G2 — routed to redundancy, never interdiction)
